'''Eazil Forney''' is an [[Andoran]] farmer who lives near the village of [[Arien]].

==Appearance==
He is described as "bleary-eyed", though it is unclear whether this is a feature of his appearance or due to him drinking too much the previous night.

==Activities==
Eazil drinks too much at Arien's only inn, and is unable to drive his cart home. He spends the night in the village, and the following morning is called by the innkeeper to see if he can give a lift to [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Mat Cauthon]], who had performed at the inn the previous night to earn their dinner and bed. Eazil gives them a lift east, and they sprawl in the straw of his cart for at least five miles.{{ref/book|1|31}}
